stem: If three particles A, B and C are having velocities \(\vec{v}_A\), \(\vec{v}_B\) and \(\vec{v}_C\) which of the following formula gives the relative velocity of A with respect to B
_note: Options (A) and (B) are printed at the foot of the right column of p-14; (C) and (D) at the top of the left column of p-15. Verified at 3x magnification: (A) is a sum, (B) carries the subscript C in the middle term, (C) is A minus B, (D) is C minus A.
